question: 8) Which of the following best describes why you might use 'elif' instead of multiple separate if statements?

options.a: 'elif' is purely syntactic sugar and doesn't change logic.
options.b: 'elif' allows checking multiple conditions in one if-else chain, stopping after the first true condition.
options.c: 'elif' must always be used after an 'else'.
options.d: 'elif' will execute all conditions that evaluate to True.
